answer: WorkUnit.routing (vendor, model, role, fallbacks) resolves solely through tools/agentrail/agentrail/rails.toml. A known triple returns ResolvedRail; an unknown triple returns closed id AS-ROUTING-UNKNOWN-RAIL. test_no_rival_core AST-walks production agentspec/agentrail and stays green; a planted RAIL_REGISTRY fires. Hardcoding a vendor default in the resolver turns the unknown-rail test red. No second rail table was introduced.
